title: A Noetherian filtered colimit of etale algebras has finite separable fibres
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $B=\varinjlim_{i\in J}B_i$ be a filtered colimit, in the category of commutative $A$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], of etale $A$-algebras $B_i$, i.e. of $A$-algebras such that $\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (equivalently, by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], $A\to B_i$ is an etale ring map in the sense of Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00U1). Assume $B$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $\mathfrak p\subset A$ be a prime with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Then there are only finitely many primes $\mathfrak q_1,\ldots,\mathfrak q_r\subset B$ ($r\ge0$) lying over $\mathfrak p$; the canonical ring map $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\prod_{j=1}^r\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$, $b\otimes\lambda\mapsto(\bar b\,\bar\lambda)_j$ ($\bar b$ the image of $b$ in $\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$, $\bar\lambda$ the image of $\lambda$ under the map $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$ induced by $A\to B$), is an isomorphism; and each field extension $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\subset\kappa(\mathfrak q_j)$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

proof.text: By the reduced zero-dimensional fibre lemma, C=κ(p)⊗_A B is reduced and has Krull dimension at most zero.
The fibre is Noetherian. Apply Mathlib IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero (Tag 00KH); its prime spectrum is finite.

The fibre-prime correspondence e identifies Spec C with F, the primes of B over p. Transfer finiteness along e. Choose the residue-field identifications θ supplied by the same theorem; each is compatible with the canonical scalar map from C.

Use Mathlib IsArtinianRing.equivPi to decompose reduced Artinian C into quotients by its maximal ideals. Reindex these maximal ideals by F via e and the prime-maximal equivalence. Each maximal quotient maps bijectively to its residue field by Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField; compose with θ. The resulting ring equivalence E has components ψ_q, as checked by the compatibility of θ and Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_residueField_mk. Hence RingHom.pi ψ is bijective.

For q∈F and y∈κ(q), form a product tuple with q-component y. Surjectivity of RingHom.pi ψ yields x∈C with ψ_q(x)=y. Equip κ(q) with the κ(p)-algebra structure induced by ρ_q. The tensor lift formula verifies scalar compatibility. Apply the separable-image lemma to ψ_q and x; thus every y is separable, giving Algebra.IsSeparable.

lean.statement: theorem finite_separable_fibers_of_etale_colimit (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {I : Type v} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (D : I ⥤ CommAlgCat.{v} A) [HasColimit D] (hD : ∀ i : I, Algebra.Etale A (D.obj i)) [IsNoetherianRing ↥(colimit D)] (p : PrimeSpectrum A) : let B := ↥(colimit D) let F := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) ⁻¹' {p} let ρ : (q : F) → p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField := fun q ↦ Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.1.asIdeal (Algebra.ofId A B) congr($(q.2.symm).asIdeal) let ψ : (q : F) → p.asIdeal.Fiber B →+* q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField := fun q ↦ (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (ρ q) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField) (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom Finite F ∧ Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi ψ) ∧ ∀ q : F, letI := (ρ q).toRingHom.toAlgebra Algebra.IsSeparable p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField
